pages.title: When Things Go Wrong
pages.text:
If multiple bars hit critical at once — maybe after a long trip far from base — do not panic. Address groups one at a time, starting with the penalty that hurts most in your current situation.

$(#e05252)In combat or exploring:$() fix Proteins (attack) and Dairy (knockback) first.
$(#52c252)Back at base:$() fix Fruits (health regen) and Vegetables (saturation) for recovery.

pages.title: Quick Fix Foods
pages.text:
Keep these high-nutrition emergency foods in your inventory for quick recovery:

$(bold)Cooked Beef$() — fastest Proteins top-up per item.
$(bold)Golden Carrot$() — fast Vegetables recovery.
$(bold)Apple$() — widely available, decent Fruits nutrition.
$(bold)Milk Bucket$() — instant Dairy coverage and also removes debuffs.

pages.title: The Milk Trick
pages.text:
$(bold)Milk Bucket$() not only fills the Dairy bar — it also removes all active status effects including nutrition penalties.

If you are stacking multiple penalties at once, drinking a milk bucket gives you a clean slate and buys time to properly address the underlying bar levels. Keep at least one in your hotbar when venturing far from home.

pages.title: Nutritional Debt
pages.text:
If a bar has been at zero for a sustained period, you may be in $(#e05252)Nutritional Debt$() — a stronger debuff state. Refilling the bar does not immediately clear debt.

To recover: keep the group above zero consistently. Do not let it drop back to empty while recovering. Eat from that group multiple times over the next in-game day to work off the debt.

pages.title: Sleep to Recover
pages.text:
Sleep is the most powerful recovery tool in Nourished. Even if not all bars are above the bonus threshold, sleeping with all bars above $(bold)zero$() prevents debt accumulation and gives a partial recovery.

If you are in a rough state, prioritize getting every bar above the critical line, then sleep. The next morning you will be in a much better position to top up properly.
